title: Senior Full Stack Developer (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (AI-Augmented Development)

**Experience:** 6–10 years | **Type:** Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who has owned products end-to-end — designing, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining them in production — and who works the way modern engineers work: with AI tools deeply integrated into their daily workflow. You should have hands-on, demonstrable experience using AI coding assistants and LLM APIs in real projects, not just experimentation. You will work across the entire product development lifecycle: from requirements and architecture through development, QA, release, and long-term maintenance of live systems.

Key ResponsibilitiesDevelopment

* Design, develop, and ship features across the full stack — frontend (web UI), backend services/APIs, and database layers.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate development, refactoring, and code review — while maintaining full ownership of code quality and correctness.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, estimates, and implementation plans.
* Build and consume REST/GraphQL APIs and integrate third-party services (payments, auth, email, AI/LLM APIs).

AI Integration

* Design and build AI-powered product features using LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or similar): chat assistants, summarization, extraction, classification, semantic search.
* Apply prompt engineering, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), embeddings/vector search, and function/tool calling where appropriate.
* Evaluate AI feature quality: measure accuracy, handle hallucinations, add guardrails, and manage cost/latency trade-offs.

Testing & Quality

* Own quality for the features you build: write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests — and use AI tools to generate and expand test coverage efficiently.
* Define test plans and acceptance criteria; perform functional, regression, and performance testing before releases.
* Set up and maintain automated test suites in CI/CD pipelines.
* Reproduce, triage, and root-cause bugs from QA and production, using AI-assisted debugging where it speeds up resolution.

Maintenance & Production Support

* Maintain and enhance existing production applications — bug fixes, security patches, dependency upgrades, performance tuning.
* Monitor production systems (logs, metrics, alerts), diagnose incidents, and drive them to resolution.
* Perform database maintenance: schema migrations, query optimization, data repair/backfill scripts.
* Refactor legacy code and reduce technical debt without disrupting live users.

Full Product Lifecycle Ownership

* Participate in all phases: discovery, requirements, architecture, development, testing, deployment, release, and post-release support.
* Work with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape scope and priorities.
* Plan and execute releases, including rollback strategies and zero-downtime deployments.
* Contribute to documentation: technical specs, runbooks, API docs, release notes.
* Mentor junior developers, including on effective and responsible AI tool usage.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 2 full product lifecycles taken from concept to production and ongoing maintenance.
* Proven daily use of AI development tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or open-source models).
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern frontend framework (React, Vue, or Angular).
* Strong backend experience with Node.js (or Python/Java/.NET).
* Solid command of SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL): schema design, indexing, migrations, query optimization.
* Hands-on testing experience: unit/integration frameworks (Jest, Vitest, Playwright/Cypress).
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Production operations experience: monitoring, logging, live debugging, incident response.
* Understanding of security fundamentals.
* Strong communication skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience building agentic workflows (multi-step tool use, MCP servers, agent frameworks/SDKs).
* RAG pipeline experience: chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.
* Experience with serverless platforms or BaaS (Supabase, Firebase).
* Data migration experience.
* Prior work on SaaS or multi-tenant products.

Pay: ₹1,600,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

AI Coding Tools (Copilot/Cursor)  
CI/CD  
Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)  
GraphQL/REST APIs  
JavaScript/TypeScript  
LLM APIs  
Node.js  
Prompt Engineering  
RAG  
React  
SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL)  
System Architecture  
Unit/Integration Testing

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Role Description**

This is a full-time on-site role in the Greater Kolkata Area for a Full Stack Engineer with minimum 2 years of experience. You'll will be responsible for developing, and maintaining our Agentic AI platform that comprise both front-end and back-end systems.

**Qualifications :**

* Back-End Web Development and Full-Stack Development skills
* 2–6 years building web apps/APIs with TypeScript/Node.js and Python (it's a must)
* Solid SQL + data modeling on Postgres/Supabase; understanding of transactions, indexes, and performance.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and handling OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and background jobs/queues.
* Front-end chops in **React/Next.js** (or similar).
* Experience with **Postgres/Supabase**, REST/GraphQL, and OAuth flows.
* Comfort with **LLM tooling** (OpenAI API), **embeddings/vector DB**, and RAG patterns.
* Bonus: n8n/Make.com, Airtable/HubSpot, PDF processing, scraping, WebSockets.
* Software Development expertise with a focus on scalable and maintainable code
* Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Experience in Agile development methodologies is a plus
* Ability to work collaboratively in on-site teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a must.

**What you'll be responsible for :**

* Ship end-to-end features for our agentic AI products (lead enrichment, tender intelligence, inbox agents, internal ops bots).
* Build clean APIs & web apps (auth, role-based access, real-time dashboards).
* Integrate CRMs, calendars, email, and third-party APIs; design reliable automations.
* Work with vector search/RAG, PDF parsing, scraping pipelines, and structured exports.
* Own quality: tests, monitoring, and performance on production workloads.

**Why DDL Labs?**

Join DDL Labs to build production AI agents that real teams use daily—ship fast, learn faster, and own the whole stack.

* **Own the vertical slice.** You’ll take features from **UI → API → DB → deploy → metrics**, and see your work go live within days, not quarters.
* **Direct user exposure.** Sit in on discovery calls, watch dashboards move, and co-design with customers—your decisions won’t vanish into a backlog abyss.
* **Comp & growth**: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives, rapid responsibility growth, and a clear path to leading projects/people as we scale.
* **Shippable culture.** Small team, high trust, crisp specs, code reviews that teach—not gatekeep. We ship thin slices, measure, and iterate.
* Hybrid, performance based incentives, rapid growth **+ company-sponsored Health Insurance**.

**Company Description :**

DDL Labs creates customized Autonomous and Agentic AI Workforces designed for speed, scalability, and quality. Specializing in conversational AI agents and co-pilots, our solutions handle complex queries, streamline task management, and enhance efficiency. With adaptability built in, our AI integrates seamlessly into popular communication channels such as WhatsApp, Slack, and email, offering no-code, cost-effective solutions. We empower businesses to manage tasks effortlessly within their preferred platforms.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Work from home

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We are seeking a proactive and skilled **Full Stack Developer** with **1 to 3 years of hands-on experience** to join our growing engineering team on a full-time remote basis.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications from front to back. You will collaborate directly with product management, design, and QA teams to ship clean, efficient, and well-tested code.

*Note: This is a remote position, but candidates* ***must be living in Kolkata*** *to facilitate occasional team meetups, local onboarding, and synchronized working hours.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Full Lifecycle Development:** Design, build, test, and deploy end-to-end features using Node.js/Express for backend services and React.js for modern web user interfaces.
* **API Architecture:** Build, document, and consume secure RESTful APIs and modern endpoints (GraphQL integration experience is a plus).
* **Database Management:** Write, optimize, and maintain database schemas and complex queries across both relational (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and non-relational (MongoDB) databases.
* **UI/UX Implementation:** Translate Figma design mockups and product specs into responsive, fast, and accessible cross-browser front-end interfaces.
* **Code Quality & Testing:** Write unit and integration tests, perform code reviews, and optimize application performance and load times.
* **Collaborative Remote Workflow:** Actively participate in agile daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings using Jira, Slack, and Git/GitHub.

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of professional full-stack web development experience.
* **Location:** Must currently reside in Kolkata
* **Front-End Stack:** Proficiency in **React.js**, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind CSS, and state management tools (Redux, Zustand, or Context API).
* **Back-End Stack:** Strong hands-on backend development experience with **Node.js** and Express.js.
* **Databases:** Working knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB).
* **Version Control:** Solid experience with **Git/GitHub** workflows (pull requests, branching strategies, rebase/merge).
* **Deployment & Cloud:** Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Vercel, Render) and containerization tools (Docker) is a strong plus.
* **Remote Setup:** Must have a reliable home office setup, high-speed internet connection, and power backup.
